idea-plugin.name: Commit History Search
idea-plugin.description: Search for a text string inside the diffs of your Git commit history, directly in the IDE. Equivalent of 'git log -S' and 'git log -G': the commits where the string was added, removed or modified are listed, and the diff of the matching file opens in the IDE diff viewer. The IDE searches commit messages and hashes natively; this plugin searches what the commits actually changed. Limit: the scan covers the whole history of the current branch and skips merge commits; the result list shows at most the 500 most recent matching commits. The search runs in the background and can be cancelled.
idea-plugin.change-notes: First release: search a string in the diffs of your Git history (merge commits are skipped), list the matching commits and files, and open the diff of a result in the IDE.

action.description: Search a text string in the diffs of the Git history
